name: Bulgarian St. Stephen Church
scope: The standing Bulgarian St. Stephen Iron Church on the Golden Horn after its 2018 restoration. The church includes the entrance bell tower, five-sided apse, short transept, zinc sheet roof, iron-clad three-aisle nave and cast ornament.
era: Standing iron church following the 2018 municipal restoration

originalReview.notes: Dated July 1 issue and map-free construction scale. Page 15 establishes prefabricated window spacing and size. Full Plate VIII shows the erected factory trial from the entrance and side. The lower margin credits Wilh. Otto for the phototype.

review.method: Exact Qualla screening and the Silesian Library item-specific public-domain record for the 1895 original issue and Plate VIII.
review.notes: The exact Qualla postcard was screened for provenance first. Its earliest uploader links a Wikipedia copy, without a traceable publication or credited author for that scan. Modeling uses the holding library’s dated and explicitly public-domain native issue and the municipal restoration report for factual details.
